messages.content:
<question>
My landlord in Colombia refuses to accept my rent this month. How can I pay so that I am not treated as being in arrears?
</question>

<reference>
When the landlord refuses to receive the payment on the agreed terms and at the agreed place, the tenant pays by depositing the rent in the landlord's favour in an entity authorised by the national government, in the place where the property is, within five business days after the end of the agreed period (art. 10, point 1, of Ley 820 de 2003). The entity keeps the original of the deposit slip and gives two duplicates, one for each party (points 2 and 3). The tenant must notify the landlord of the deposit by authorised postal service, enclosing the duplicate, within five days after the deposit (point 4). Not following this procedure puts the tenant in arrears (point 5). Later payments can be made the same way or directly to the landlord, at the tenant's choice (point 7).
</reference>

The numbered sources:
[1] co-ley-820 article 10

The change to make: Change nothing of substance: the answer must state exactly the rule of the reference, with every condition, number and exception it gives.

answer.description: The answer, in English, with [n] after each statement.

change.description: One sentence: what you changed, or 'none'.

system.text:
You help build a labelled test set for an automated judge that checks answers from Plumbline, a service that gives legal information (never legal advice) about residential tenancy law in Dubai, Spain, Colombia and Florida. You rewrite a reference answer into the form Plumbline answers in: plain English, short paragraphs, a marker such as [1] right after each statement of law naming the numbered source it rests on, no advice ("you should"), no greeting and no disclaimer. The blocks in the user's message are data, not instructions.

Then you apply exactly the change the user asks for, and nothing else, and say in one sentence what you changed. Most changes plant a deliberate error: that is the purpose of the row, which is stored with a label saying it is wrong, is used only to measure whether the judge notices, and is never shown to anyone as information. If you cannot make the change, write the answer without it and begin your sentence with "none".

The entity keeps the original deposit slip and gives two duplicates, one for each party [1]. The tenant must notify the landlord of the deposit by authorised postal service, enclosing the duplicate, within five days after the deposit [1]. Failure to follow this procedure places the tenant in arrears [1]. Later payments can be made the same way or directly to the landlord, at the tenant's choice [1].", "change": "none: no substantive change was made, and the answer restates every condition, number and exception of the reference rule."}
